messages:
emily: Quick sync 17: PR 4217 is blocked on one runtime clarification and a tiny snippet fix. Holding merge until both are cleared.

sam: Runtime: default prefetch is OFF. If you opt into prefetch (route config `prefetch: true`) we only write to the KV after a full, non-streaming success. No cache writes on fallback or streaming responses.

alex: Noted. Current PR shows example as `client.prefetch = true`, which is wrong
Prefetch is a server-side route setting. I'll replace the client-only code with a server YAML + client call example.

mike: Heads-up: docs CI flagged the batching-guide anchor (the heading was renamed last week). Linkcheck fails until I update the href. Also preview rendering had a YAML indent bug (looks like our markdown renderer collapses leading spaces).

emily: Can we do this: sam adds one-sentence "runtime behavior" callout, alex updates snippets, mike fixes link and adjusts markdown indent. If deploy-bot shows green, I'll merge.

sam: Added runtime note in the PR: "When prefetch is enabled, KV caching is only attempted after a completed, non-streaming 200 response. Streaming or partial responses and early errors do not populate the KV cache to prevent inconsistent prefixes." Pushed commit e3f9.

alex: Swapped the client flag for a server config YAML and the minimal client call. Example in PR now:```yaml
route: /generate
prefetch: true
model: redwood/gpt-small
```then a client call: `client.request({ route: '/generate', input: 'tl;dr' })`. Pushed f7b2.

mike: Fixed batching-guide anchor and normalized YAML fences so preview renders correctly. Pushed linkfix-01.

deploy-bot: docs-preview: rebuild triggered for PR #4217 \u2014 https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/4217 (linkcheck warning resolved).

emily: Preview looks good. Merge incoming in ~5m unless objections.

sam: no objections.

alex: good to go.

deploy-bot: PR merged by emily at 1769012400.
